learned.why: The privacy page described visits, ideas and email but not AI processing, microphone failure codes kept 12 months, or the sign-in cookie and connected accounts (found by the 2026-11-20 privacy sweep).
learned.probe: grep:site/legalpages.js::(?s)Automated processing.*Voice.*Signing in and connected accounts
learned.action: site/legalpages.js PRIVACY carries a card for each; change it in the same change as the code it describes

learned.why: All four domains expire together on 2027-11-10. The 2026-11-20 continuity sweep found auto-renew off on every one; the owner turned it on the same day (Cloudflare Registrar API read back: auto_renew true on all four). If it is ever switched off again the domains lapse unless someone pays on time.
learned.action: auto-renew is the owner's setting because it commits a payment; the system re-reads it weekly and files Q-BLIND-RENEW-* 60 days out for any domain where it is off

learned.why: The name search covered the US register only; EUIPO, WIPO Madrid and UKIPO were not reachable from the session that ran it (found by the 2026-11-20 ip sweep).
learned.action: search EUIPO eSearch, WIPO Global Brand Database and UKIPO for ULTRASTABLE in classes 9 and 42, add rows to searched and empty unsearched

learned.why: Since 2026-09-01 Cloudflare fails every D1 query on the free plan once the daily row limit is passed, until midnight UTC; before that date overage was tolerated (found by the 2026-11-20 platform-risk sweep, developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-09-01-d1-free-tier-limit-enforcement).
learned.action: the free-tier governor (seed/worker/src/freetier.js) samples d1 rows read and written and slows the tick before the limit

learned.why: EU AI Act Article 50 has applied since 2026-08-02: a person must be told when content is AI-made and the output must carry a machine-readable mark. Pages the system builds at /s/<id> carried neither (found by the 2026-11-20 legal sweep).
learned.action: site/worker.js serves every built page with a generator meta tag and a visible 'Written by AI' label

learned.why: POST /api/meta/ingest is public and wrote to KV for 12 months with no limit, so anyone could use up the daily KV writes and stop the site's own state from saving (found by the 2026-11-20 security sweep).
learned.action: per-connection hourly cap and a global daily cap; a refused event writes nothing (site/site.test.mjs)

learned.why: Gmail, Yahoo and Microsoft expect a List-Unsubscribe header with one-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058) on automated mail; the intro lane has an opt-out line and domain suppression but sends no such header (found by the 2026-11-20 outreach sweep; the lane is in dry-run, so nothing has been sent without it).
learned.action: add List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post headers to the intro message and an endpoint that records the opt-out, before mode leaves dry-run
